Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior

Local: 100% presencial - Rio Tavares

Regime: (CLT)

Início: Imediato

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por tecnologia, com espírito colaborativo e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas. Se você tem experiência com frameworks modernos, banco de dados relacionais e linguagens versáteis, essa vaga é para você!

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:

  • Superior completo ou em Curso, em fases finais, em Sistema da Informação, Ciências da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com Angular e React
  • Domínio de JavaScript
  • Experiência com Python
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL (modelagem de dados, queries otimizadas)
  • APIs e integração entre frontend e backend

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Rust
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (frontend e backend)
  • Práticas de CI/CD e versionamento com Git
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban)
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Docker e arquitetura de microsserviços

Perfil Comportamental

  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade
  • Capacidade de autogestão e organização
  • Boa comunicação e espírito de equipe
  • Interesse em aprender e se atualizar constantemente

O que Oferecemos

  • Ambiente colaborativo e com foco em inovação
  • Flexibilidade de horário
  • Participação em projetos desafiadores e com impacto real
  • Acesso a cursos, treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento
  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$1.000,00
  • Auxílio Transporte compatível com o seu trajeto

title: Vendedor de Serviços/Executivo de Contas
description:
Responsabilidades

  1. Prospecção de clientes corporativos:
  • Identificar empresas que possam se beneficiar dos serviços oferecidos.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de pesquisa, redes sociais (especialmente LinkedIn) e networking.
  1. Agendamento e realização de reuniões comerciais:
  • Contatar decisores (gerentes, diretores, RH, compras, etc.).
  • Apresentar a empresa e seus diferenciais.
  1. Diagnóstico de necessidades:
  • Entender os desafios e demandas do cliente.
  • Personalizar a proposta de acordo com as necessidades do negócio.
  1. Elaboração e envio de propostas comerciais:
  • Criar propostas claras, detalhadas e com foco em valor agregado.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das negociações.
  1. Negociação e fechamento de contratos:
  • Negociar prazos, condições comerciais e valores.
  • Formalizar acordos e garantir a satisfação do cliente.
  1. Pós-venda e fidelização:
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes ativos.
  • Buscar oportunidades de vendas adicionais (upsell e cross-sell).
  1. Relatórios e metas:
  • Atualizar CRM com informações de clientes e oportunidades.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (número de visitas, propostas enviadas, taxa de conversão, etc.).

Formação:

  • Ensino médio completo (mínimo).
  • Superior em áreas como Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou afins é um diferencial.

Experiência:

  • Vivência em vendas consultivas B2B, especialmente de serviços (não produtos).
  • Conhecimento do setor em que atua (ex: RH, terceirização, tecnologia, etc.).

Habilidades técnicas:

  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM .
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas consultivas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Competências comportamentais (soft skills):

  • Proatividade e iniciativa.
  • Facilidade para construir relacionamentos.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.
  • Persistência e resiliência.
  • Capacidade de ouvir e entender o cliente.

title: Analista Financeiro
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A SEW é a plataforma em nuvem nº 1 para Energia e Água , oferecendo soluções SaaS (Software como Serviço) voltadas para Engajamento Digital de Clientes , Engajamento de Equipes de Campo e Inteligência Artificial/Aprendizado de Máquina aplicadas ao setor de energia e utilidades.

Nosso objetivo é capacitar as empresas de energia e saneamento a aprimorar o atendimento ao cliente, otimizar a eficiência operacional e maximizar o retorno sobre investimentos por meio dos aplicativos da plataforma SEW, que utilizam tecnologias de mobilidade, IA, aprendizado de máquina e computação em nuvem .

Procurando o emprego dos sonhos? Na SEW, buscamos ajudar nossos colaboradores a encontrar propósito e paixão no que fazem. Junte-se a nós para transformar a forma como o mundo utiliza energia e água e faça parte de uma equipe inovadora e talentosa !

Descrição da Posição

Buscamos um(a) profissional proativo(a) e organizado(a) para apoiar nossas operações financeiras e administrativas no Brasil .

Essa função é responsável por coordenar as atividades diárias do escritório e auxiliar nos processos financeiros, em colaboração com nosso escritório de contabilidade terceirizado e a equipe financeira da América Latina (LATAM Finance) .

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto de contato com o provedor terceirizado de contabilidade e tributos, garantindo a entrega pontual de relatórios e o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais.
  • Apoiar as operações administrativas diárias (coordenação de fornecedores, logística, documentação e materiais de escritório).
  • Auxiliar na preparação de relatórios internos e na organização das informações para o fechamento financeiro mensal.
  • Coordenar a comunicação com consultores externos e autoridades locais, quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para a implementação de procedimentos financeiros internos e manter a documentação alinhada às políticas regionais.

Requisitos de Formação e Experiência

  • Formação: Ensino superior em Contabilidade, Finanças ou áreas correlatas .
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em suporte financeiro.
  • Idiomas: Proficiência em inglês (mandatório). Espanhol será um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos: Noções de processos contábeis e fiscais brasileiros , com experiência de trabalho junto a prestadores de serviços externos.
  • Competências: Forte capacidade de organização , atenção aos detalhes e autonomia para trabalhar de forma independente.

Por que trabalhar na SEW?

  • Faça parte de uma organização guiada por propósito , criando soluções de alto impacto para os setores de energia e água.
  • Colabore com uma equipe talentosa e inovadora em projetos de ponta.
  • Tenha oportunidades reais de crescimento profissional e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
  • Atue em uma cultura que valoriza a diversidade, a criatividade e a colaboração .

Diversidade e Inclusão

A SEW é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades . Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas **independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, gravidez, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência, informações genéticas, condição de veterano protegido ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.

title: Sales Manager
description:
The Brazil Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing a clearly defined Sales strategy in the LATAM/Brazil region and plan in a manner that supports consistent business growth and enhances SUBNET brand equity. The position is responsible for planning, organizing, staffing, training, and managing all Sales functions in this region to achieve SUBNET objectives of sales, growth, profitability, and visibility that is consistent with the corporate direction.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic Sales Leadership

• Execute executive-level sales goals aligned with corporate strategy.

• Develop and track KPIs for all sales programs, reporting progress to senior leadership.

• Provide detailed and accurate sales forecasting and pipeline visibility.

• Define and manage incentive programs to drive sales performance.

• Monitor market, customer, and competitor trends, providing strategic insights.

• Maintain strong relationships with the senior executive team to ensure alignment.

Team & Talent Management

• Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing sales team through structured

development programs, 1:1 meetings, and ensure alignment with global objectives.

• Oversee hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management.

• Conduct regular performance reviews, goal setting, and coaching sessions.

• Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus. Account Development & Customer Engagement

• Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

• Sponsor strategic accounts and participate in closing high-value opportunities.

• Design and enforce customer service standards, monitor performance, and evaluate outcomes.

Channel & Partner Strategy

• Develop and execute a global sales strategy, including OEMs, independent reps, and

international partners.

• Collaborate with Marketing to build effective channel programs, brand management and go-to-market strategies.

Sales Operations & Forecasting

• Deliver timely and accurate sales forecasts and performance reports.

• Lead bid management efforts, proposal development and strategic deal structuring.

• Regional Leadership and management of EMEA personnel: hiring, onboarding, coaching, task assignment, and performance management.

• Accountable for fiscal responsibility, financial metrics and business compliance.

Required

• Written and oral proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish and English

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field; MBA is a strong asset.

• 5+ years of experience in complex solution sales, in enterprise software or professional services.

• Proven leadership in managing international sales teams and driving performance.

• Strong technical communication and ability to translate complex solutions into business value.

• High integrity, ethical conduct, and alignment with corporate values.

• Authorized to work in the LATAM/Brazil and travel to U.S., Canada, and internationally.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Why choose us?

Page Outsourcing is one of the fastest growing Global Outsourced providers, having more than doubled its headcount in the past 18 months to support major clients across UK, North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America. This unprecedented expansion is due to our unique positioning within the global outsourcing industry and our ability to offer tailored, multi-regional outsourcing solutions, across the full total talent spectrum. Underpinned by our best-in-class Page Group infrastructure, we have an unmatched opportunity to deliver industry leading performance.

What will you be doing?

The objective of the role is to support the delivery of our client's RPO program. Working closely with the Page Outsourcing and the key client stakeholders, you'll be working to deliver on your roles each month, owning candidate generation and selection, working with hiring managers to take them through their shortlisted candidates for their respective roles and then supporting the interview process. You'll then manage offer negotiations through to successful onboarding.

We therefore seek customer focused individuals to join our team of Talent Acquisition Partners. It is likely you'll have worked in or supported with recruitment previously and will have an inquisitive nature with a passion for helping people reach their potential through supporting their job search.

Key Activities

  • Engage with Talent Acquisition Manager and Hiring Managers to understand role requirements, overall expectations, timeframes, candidate pool quality and quantity
  • Support Account Director / Account Manager on monthly reporting at all stages of the recruitment process for review with client. Inclusion of statistics on D&I applications and conversion rates
  • Become Client’s storyteller, sharing inspiring information with candidates about client, their business strategy, culture, current and future opportunities.
  • Leverage all aspects of sourcing including but not limited to PageGroup systems, Client ATS, LinkedIn, job board mining, internet sourcing, social networking, employee referrals and networking events
  • Identify talent in hard-to-reach places, learn about their skills and motivations and educate them on our client’s culture and opportunities
  • Conduct research to identify, evaluate and prioritise target companies and locations to attract talent from
  • Proactively develop, grow and maintain a network of external prospects to feed into and nurture clients talent pools
  • Proactively provide data and market insights to stakeholders and business leaders making strong recommendations to inform key recruiting decisions
  • Maintain accurate and well-ordered documentation in our applicant tracking system on candidates, hiring manager’s interactions and other recruiting activities.

What we are looking for?

  • Fluent in Portuguese & English
  • Experience gained in agency and / or onsite recruitment, preferably with the Chemical and Manufacturing sectors
  • Broad exposure to recruitment ATS / VMS platforms
  • Strong working knowledge of sourcing tools, channels, and networking opportunities in your chosen markets of expertise
  • Excellent communications skills
  • Proactive, able to prioritise and manage own workload
  • Reliable and well organised
  • Team player with a flexible and confident approach to work
  • Ability to negotiate effectively
  • Ability to influence people, sell ideas and concepts and gain commitment
  • Customer focused

How will you be rewarded?

  • We offer a comprehensive renumeration and benefits package, including:
  • A career with PageGroup – offering scope across all of brands and all our client settings, UK and beyond.
  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible working
  • Defined career progression
  • Family friendly enhanced policies

title: City Manager
description:
About the job

1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Events Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Assistente de Implantação
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.

Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.

Descritivo:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Implantação, responsável pela execução de atividades de infraestrutura e instalação de equipamentos eletrônicos, garantindo a qualidade, segurança e conformidade com os padrões internos da empresa.

  • Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem para interligação de equipamentos, painéis e dispositivos eletrônicos realizando trabalhos em altura (NR35)

  • Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
  • Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.
  • Encaminhar para os responsáveis qualquer evento ou incidente de Segurança da Informação ou Privacidade.

Conhecimentos:

  • Manuseio de ferramentas elétricas (parafusadeira, furadeira, esmerilhadeira)
  • Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone, P2, P10, DB9, Terminais elétricos)

Vivência na liderança de pessoas;

Disponibilidade para turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Senior Manager, Engineering Ops (Devops)
description:
Title : Senior Manager, Engineering Operations

Level : Manager or Senior Manager

Location : Brazil

Work setup : Remote (within 1hr from São Paulo, Brazil) *Eventually will be hybrid, 2-3 days in

office once we open an office next year

Department : Engineering

Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to

the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’

portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater

and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India.

Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent,

Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Head of Engineering, Engineering Operations to lead our

engineering operations which includes areas such DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE),

CI/CD, Release management etc for our cloud-based systems and applications. This role is

pivotal in ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and availability of our systems while driving

innovation in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and operational efficiency. You will be responsible for

crisis management, improving system performance, cost and fostering a culture of operational

excellence.

Responsibilities

● Leadership and strategy

○ Lead and mentor teams in DevOps, SRE, and Engineering Operations, fostering

a culture of collaboration, ownership, and innovation.○ Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for engineering operations, aligning

with business goals and product requirements.

○ Advocate for and implement industry best practices in system reliability, DevOps,

and automation.

● Reliability and availability

○ Drive initiatives to improve the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud-

based applications and infrastructure.

○ Establish performance measurements for various system health metrics.

○ Ensure robust incident management and crisis response processes to minimize

downtime and customer impact.

● DevOps and CI/CD

○ Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines to

enable seamless and automated deployment processes.

○ Leverage automation tools and practices to reduce manual interventions and

improve operational efficiency.

○ Collaborate with product and engineering teams to enable rapid and reliable

feature delivery.

● Monitoring and observability

○ Implement and maintain advanced monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to

gain deep insights into system health and performance.

○ Use observability tools (e.g., Grafana) to proactively identify and resolve issues

before they impact customers.

● Crisis and Incident Management

○ Lead crisis management efforts during high-severity incidents, ensuring quick

resolution and effective communication with stakeholders.

○ Conduct root cause analyses and drive post-mortem reviews to identify and

address operational gaps.

● Team Development and Collaboration

○ Build, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering operations team with

expertise in DevOps and SRE practices across multiple geolocations.

○ Foster close collaboration with development, data, and product teams to align

engineering operations with overall business objectives.

○ Promote a blameless post-mortem culture to encourage continuous learning and

improvement.

● Cost Optimization and Security

○ Optimize cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining system reliability and

scalability.

○ Implement robust security practices in operations to ensure compliance with

industry standards and regulations.

Qualifications

● 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years in leadership roles

● Proven track record of improving system reliability, availability, and performance for

cloud-based applications.

FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS

Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.

No FTR, utilizamos o Direito como uma ferramenta para negócios e mitigação de riscos.

Com escritórios no RJ e SP, atuação full service e multidisciplinar (desde o consultivo ao contencioso), o FTR tem como um dos seus principais pilares a inovação constante e caracteriza-se por uma dinâmica de trabalho extremamente ágil, estrutura horizontal e acesso direto aos sócios, permitindo um crescimento profissional rápido, multidisciplinar e integrado.

Há anos, o FTR impulsiona e relaciona-se com diversas startups e empresas de inovação, para utilizar a inteligência dos dados em otimização de eficiência e mitigação de riscos de clientes.

Atualmente, FTR desenvolve projetos com IA, plataformas de analytics e programas de GRC para gestão, compliance, mitigação de riscos | fraudes. Vivemos a rotina de projetos e nossa equipe é multidisciplinar e ágil. Trazemos soluções aos clientes. Oferecemos inovação ao mercado. Somos inquietos por natureza. E sempre mantemos nosso lema de: essência, experiência e excelência.

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados complexos e gerar insights estratégicos;
